name: InterPro/Pfam
closes_gap: family registry and lexical DUF triage
rationale: 6,532 families frozen 2026-10-01; offline seed-label correction 2026-10-05. Seed labels are lexical triage, not scientific review.

name: UniProtKB and UniRef member expansion
rationale: Two bounded PF04149 members frozen for residue-range visualization; coordinates are source annotations, not functional validation or representative sampling.

name: MGnify Proteins
rationale: Implemented; the 2026-10-01 external run reported 12 MGYP rows. MGnify is scoring context, not experimentally established family function.

name: AlphaFold DB
rationale: Implemented; 12 prediction rows reported in the external 2026-10-01 run. No committed source freeze.

name: CATH-Gene3D FunFams
rationale: Implemented; external 2026-10-01 run returned zero rows with four persistent fetch failures. Zero rows do not establish biological absence.

name: NCBI Batch CD-Search / CDD
rationale: Implemented; external 2026-10-01 run produced a zero-row CDD snapshot. Specific and superfamily hits have different scoring implications.

name: NCBIFAM protein family models
rationale: Saved-table parser, freeze command and scorer are implemented. No source table or committed hit snapshot was found in the ignored-file-inclusive inventory.

name: eggNOG-mapper annotations
rationale: Parser, freeze command and scorer are implemented. The 2026-10-01 expanded run explicitly omitted eggNOG because no saved input was available.

name: EFI-GNT Pfam Neighbor Mapping Table
rationale: Saved-table parser, freeze command and context scorer are implemented; no committed export or neighborhood snapshot.

name: JGI IMG gene-neighborhood table
rationale: Parser, freeze command and context scorer implemented. Blocked pending an authorized saved export with project/release and terms provenance; do not label all IMG data restricted.

name: 3D-Beacons Network
rationale: Implemented; external 2026-10-01 run reported 19 AlphaFold DB rows through 3D-Beacons. Provider identity remains explicit.

name: RCSB PDB experimental structures
rationale: Implemented; external 2026-10-01 run found no experimental entities for its 12 proteins. An empty pilot is not a corpus-wide absence claim.

name: PDBe-KB entity annotations
closes_gap: residue and domain annotations on PDB entities
rationale: Implemented; 2026-10-01 external run wrote an empty snapshot from empty RCSB seeds, so it did not demonstrate live annotation coverage.

name: Rhea reactions
rationale: Implemented; external 2026-10-01 run found zero linked reactions. Reaction associations can demote unknown-function status only with source evidence.

name: QuickGO molecular-function annotations
closes_gap: GO molecular function with evidence codes
rationale: Implemented; external 2026-10-01 run reported four GO:0003677 annotations for PF19054. This is a historical pilot result, not a newly curated claim.

name: STRING v12.0 functional associations
rationale: Implemented; 2026-10-01 pilot initially failed for unsupported taxon 927661; expanded run reported four partners for A0A011PM99. Associations are contextual, not direct mechanism proof.

name: UniParc sequence archive
rationale: Implemented; 12 external pilot rows reported on 2026-10-01. UniParc provides identity support and has no direct characterization-score flag.

name: Cross-Mech curated-record references
closes_gap: reuse candidates from sibling curated corpora
rationale: 16,298 reference rows published from 2026-10-05 scan and relabeled offline 2026-10-06; no new scan or retrieval on October 6. Retain legacy provenance; further adoption awaits license review.
